What's new in Tuned 0.1.0

November 17, 2026

The first build of Tuned: a native IPTV player for Android, with a playlist and guide kept on the device, Live TV, Movies and Shows, and auto-tune to find a working stream for a live event.

New

  • Tuned: a native IPTV player for Android
  • Auto-tune: find a working English stream for a live event
  • New versions offered in the app
  • A rounded look
  • Big playlist downloads that survive a dropped connection, with a progress bar

Get Tuned for Android

A fast, quiet IPTV player for phones, tablets and Android TV. Free, with no ads. The latest version is 2.0.0.
